title: Central London Office Market Analysis - Q2 2026
snippet: Take-up of 2.6m sq ft in Q2 2026, 6% above the 10-year average. Central London vacancy unchanged at 6.3%; Midtown 4.3%; Grade A vacancy 1.9%, 1.3% in the West End and City. Prime rental growth 6.5% year on year. AI occupiers took ~500,000 sq ft in Q2.

title: Central London Office Market Dynamics - Q2 2026
snippet: Q2 2026 take-up of 2.6m sq ft, up 15% on the quarter. Vacancy 8.6%. Prime rents: West End GBP 190.00 psf, City GBP 95.00 psf. TMT 33% of take-up on AI demand. Space under construction at its lowest since Q3 2021.

title: Central London Market Update Q1 2026
snippet: Q1 2026 take-up 2.5m sq ft (-19.7% y/y). Vacancy 8.4%, below the five-year average of 10.6%. Prime West End GBP 175 psf (+6.1% y/y), City GBP 92.50 psf (+8.8%).

title: London Office Market Review 2026
snippet: Citing Savills: ~8.5m sq ft of central London completions forecast in 2026, around two-thirds pre-let; 4.85m sq ft in the City; West End completions fall to 1.6m sq ft by 2028.

title: London Office Pipeline 2027-2030: Which Major Projects Will Actually Start?
snippet: Office start volume in 2025 was ~4.8m sq ft, below the ~6.5m sq ft five-year average; refurbishments were ~two-thirds of starts.

title: Office vacancies in Docklands Core rise to the highest on record
snippet: Docklands Core vacancy, covering Canary Wharf and part of the Isle of Dogs, hit 18.6%, the highest in data back to 2003.

title: The London Office Market Q2 2026
snippet: Demand for high-quality, sustainable Grade A office space continues to outstrip supply, particularly across the West End, Midtown and the City.

title: UK office forecast calls for demand to outpace supply from mid-2027 onwards
snippet: Forecast suggests office demand will outpace new supply from mid-2027, supporting rental growth for prime space.
